extension.summary: Install video add-ons from the Tony.7.Bones repos
extension.description: Pick which video add-ons to install (POV, The Loop, Sports HD, Umbrella). Each is installed with its full dependency closure, resolved live from the repositories already on this box, then enabled so it works straight away. Run the main Tony.7.Bones Setup first so the source repositories are present.
extension.news: Skip optional dependencies — no more pulling Google Drive / cloud resolvers you didn't ask for. The installer now matches Kodi's own behaviour and resolves only required dependencies; optional imports stay on-demand. (Initial release: multiselect picker for POV, The Loop, Sports HD and Umbrella with prompt-free closure install and self-removal.)
